what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Reddio site Go to reddio.com to see the Mainnet Alpha and the description of its parallel EVM.
2 Step 2 : Try Reddio Pay Open Reddio Pay , the page the homepage banner links to for the Pay Alpha, which the banner says accepts USDC/USDT payments.
3 Step 3 : Read the points overview The points overview explains Staking Points and Task Points, so you can see what each one involves before using either.
4 Step 4 : Read the token distribution page The token distribution page lists the RDO allocation tranches and their vesting schedules.
